news.title: Dividend increased to ₹40.00
news.body: Dividend of ₹40.00 is 33% higher than last year. Ex-date: 24th July 2026 Payment date: 14th August 2026 Dividend yield will be 1.7%, which is higher than the industry average of 0.6%. Sustainability & Growth Dividend is covered by earnings (39% earnings payout ratio) but not covered by cash flows (223% cash payout ratio). The dividend has increased by an average of 24% per year over the past 10 years. However, payments have been volatile during that time. EPS is expected to grow by 58% over the next 3 years, which should provide support to the dividend and adequate earnings cover.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹97.11 (vs ₹77.86 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹97.11 (up from ₹77.86 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹28.4b (up 18% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹2.56b (up 25% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 9.0% (up from 8.5% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue is forecast to grow 15% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 11% growth forecast for the Auto Components industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 20% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 35% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: Fiem Industries Limited Recommends Final Dividend, Payable on or Before August 14, 2026
news.body:
Fiem Industries Limited announced that July 24, 2026 has been fixed as Record Date for the Final Dividend, as recommended by the Board in their meeting held May 30, 2026 at the rate of INR 40/- per equity share of INR 10/- each (i.e. 400%). The Final Dividend, if declared at the ensuing 37th AGM, will be paid or dividend warrants/DDs will be
dispatched to the shareholders on or before August 14, 2026.

Revenue is forecast to grow 16% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 11% growth forecast for the Auto Components industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 20% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 41% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
